title: Beautiful day!

title: Marcel was an excellent...
text: Marcel was an excellent guide. He picked my mother and I up from near our hotel and shared tons of information throughout the day. We had booked a group tour but ended up with a private one which was nice. The time in Montserrat was well balanced with both guided and free time. We then headed to the salt mine which was beautiful and interesting. If you speak English bring headphones for the audio guide you can listen to on your phone. title: Seamless communication!!!!
text: We have the best experience!!! Dulce, our guide, was on time to pick us up from our hotel. Communication was seamless. She gave us clear and concise instructions. Our driver, Wander, was very careful, safety first always, accommodating and treated us with great professionalism. I highly recommend this tour, giving 5 stars.
